definitions.gloss: reaching the summit; summiting; climbing to the top of a mountain
definitions.explanation: The act of successfully reaching the peak of a mountain. Used specifically for mountaineering achievements. Can also be used as a suru-verb (登頂する).

examples.japanese: エベレストに{登頂|とうちょう}した。
{悪天候|あくてんこう}のため{登頂|とうちょう}を{断念|だんねん}した。
examples.english: We gave up the summit attempt due to bad weather.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{世界|せかい}の{八千|はっせん}メートル{級|きゅう}の{山|やま}{全|すべ}てに{登頂|とうちょう}した{初|はじ}めての{日本人|にほんじん}{女性|じょせい}だ。
examples.english: She is the first Japanese woman to have summited all of the world's 8,000-meter peaks.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
～に{登頂|とうちょう}する (to summit ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登頂|とうちょう}に{成功|せいこう}する (to successfully reach the summit)
- {登頂|とうちょう}を{断念|だんねん}する (to give up the summit attempt)
- {登頂|とうちょう}を{果|は}たす (to achieve the summit)
- {初|はつ}{登頂|とうちょう} (first ascent)
- {単独|たんどく}{登頂|とうちょう} (solo summit)
- {無|む}{酸素|さんそ}{登頂|とうちょう} (summit without supplemental oxygen)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {登山|とざん}: Mountain climbing — the general activity, not specifically reaching the peak.
- {山頂|さんちょう}: The summit/peak itself — a noun referring to the location, not the act of reaching it.
